description: React component for displaying and managing installed slash commands in Mattermost, including features like filtering, token regeneration, editing, and deletion.

classes.name: InstalledCommand
classes.description: React component class for rendering an installed slash command with actions and details.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Checks if a command matches the provided filter string based on display name, description, or trigger.

methods.name: handleRegenToken
methods.description: Handles the token regeneration button click, calls the onRegenToken prop with the command.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles the delete action, calls the onDelete prop with the command.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including command details, actions, and conditional filtering.
